title: First trailer for my strategy game
author: Significant_Emu2351
selftext:
Solo dev. Arkney: Age of Crowns, a grand strategy sim in Godot with a C# simulation behind it. Going to Steam as single player plus co-op for up to 8.  
  
The code is mostly written with Claude Code and the 23 building and unit cards come from Recraft, picked and checked by me. The trailer is not AI video. It is a real save recorded through Godot's Movie Maker mode, one frame at a time, because screen capture only gave me 15 to 20 fps.  
  
If you have cut a trailer from a live simulation rather than scripted scenes, how did you keep it readable? Mine runs 93 seconds and I think that is too long.

replies.author: Significant_Emu2351
replies.body: Not sure what you mean, the price or the models?

comments.author: RepulsiveRaisin7
comments.body: This looks interesting, but imo the graphic style doesn't work, it just looks ugly. Low poly works fine in games like Diplomacy is Not an Option, but what you have is almost zero poly lol. At minimum I'd add a proper ground texture. And I feel like the terrain is too crowded with settlements.

replies.author: Significant_Emu2351
replies.body: Thank you so much for your feedback, I've received a lot of criticism on this topic, I've noted it and will address it in my next work. :)
